user_story.role: assistant acting on a person's contacts
user_story.capability: each part of a contact's name as a separate field
user_story.benefit: I can rename someone without losing their middle name, prefix or suffix

criteria.trigger: a contact is read
criteria.behavior: return `prefix`, `first_name`, `middle_name`, `last_name` and `suffix` as separate text values, each empty when the contact has none

criteria.trigger: a create or update request provides a name part
criteria.behavior: store that part with the provided value

criteria.trigger: an update request provides only a display name
criteria.behavior: keep the contact's existing prefix, middle name and suffix

criteria.trigger: an update request provides only a display name that contains the contact's existing prefix, middle name or suffix
criteria.behavior: exclude those parts from the stored first and last name

criteria.trigger: an update request changes a name part without providing a display name
criteria.behavior: set the display name to the non-empty parts joined in the order prefix, first, middle, last, suffix

criteria.trigger: a create or update request provides a name part as an empty string
criteria.behavior: clear that part

criteria.trigger: a create request provides no display name, no name part and no organization
criteria.behavior: reject the request with an error that names the missing fields

user_story.capability: phonetic names, nicknames and maiden names
user_story.benefit: I can find, address and pronounce people the way the user knows them

criteria.trigger: a contact is read
criteria.behavior: return `phonetic_first_name`, `phonetic_middle_name`, `phonetic_last_name`, `nickname` and `maiden_name`, each empty when the contact has none

criteria.trigger: a create or update request provides one of these fields with text
criteria.behavior: store that text

criteria.trigger: a create or update request provides one of these fields as an empty string
criteria.behavior: remove that field from the contact

criteria.trigger: a throwaway contact with phonetic names, a nickname and a maiden name is stored
criteria.behavior: display each value on the contact card

user_story.capability: a contact's department, phonetic company name and company-card setting
user_story.benefit: I can keep work details complete without wiping any of them

criteria.trigger: a contact is read
criteria.behavior: return `department`, `phonetic_organization` and `is_company` alongside `organization`

criteria.trigger: an update request provides an organization without a department
criteria.behavior: keep the contact's existing department

criteria.trigger: a create or update request provides a department
criteria.behavior: store it as the contact's department, clearing it when the value is empty

criteria.trigger: a create or update request provides a phonetic organization
criteria.behavior: store it, clearing it when the value is empty

criteria.trigger: a create or update request sets `is_company` to true
criteria.behavior: mark the contact to display as a company

criteria.trigger: an update request sets `is_company` to false
criteria.behavior: mark the contact to display as a person

criteria.trigger: a create or update request sets `is_company` to true for a contact that would have no organization
criteria.behavior: reject the request with an error asking for an organization

user_story.capability: a contact's related people with their relationship labels
user_story.benefit: I can answer questions such as "who is Sam's spouse?" and record new relationships

criteria.trigger: a contact is read
criteria.behavior: return `related_names` as a list of entries with `label` and `name`, using the label text the Contacts app shows for built-in labels

criteria.trigger: an update request provides `related_names`
criteria.behavior: replace the contact's related names with the provided list

criteria.trigger: a related-name entry is sent back unchanged
criteria.behavior: keep its stored form byte-identical

criteria.trigger: a new related-name entry has no label
criteria.behavior: store it with the label `other`

criteria.trigger: a related-name entry has an empty name
criteria.behavior: reject the request with an error identifying the entry

criteria.trigger: a throwaway contact has a related name with a built-in label and one with a custom label
criteria.behavior: display both names with their labels

user_story.capability: a contact's instant-messaging accounts with their service
user_story.benefit: I can tell the user how to reach someone on Skype or another messaging app

criteria.trigger: a contact is read
criteria.behavior: return `instant_messages` as a list of entries with `label`, `service` and `username`

criteria.trigger: an update request provides `instant_messages`
criteria.behavior: replace the contact's instant-message accounts with the provided list

criteria.trigger: an instant-message entry is sent back unchanged
criteria.behavior: keep its stored form byte-identical, including Apple's app identifiers

criteria.trigger: an instant-message entry has an empty service or an empty username
criteria.behavior: reject the request with an error identifying the entry

criteria.trigger: a throwaway contact has instant-message accounts
criteria.behavior: display each account's service and username

user_story.role: person whose contacts an assistant edits
user_story.capability: every field the tools do not model to survive edits
user_story.benefit: pronouns, ringtones and other Apple data are never lost

criteria.behavior: keep every stored property that the tools do not model byte-identical through any create or update request

criteria.trigger: a read-then-write-back of every field is replayed over the live snapshot
criteria.behavior: change zero contacts

criteria.trigger: an edit of a single field is replayed over the live snapshot
criteria.behavior: change only the stored lines of that field
omit pronoun data from contact reads
offer no create or update parameter for pronouns, ringtone, text tone, lunar birthday or verification code

user_story.capability: the Apple-only fields whose format is readable
user_story.benefit: I can tell the user a contact's lunar birthday or assigned ringtone

criteria.trigger: the format investigation runs
criteria.behavior: record the stored encoding of lunar birthday, ringtone, text tone and verification code taken from a throwaway contact that was given those fields on the iPhone

criteria.trigger: the lunar birthday encoding is confirmed readable
criteria.behavior: return `lunar_birthday` with its calendar, month and day, and its year when one is stored

criteria.trigger: the ringtone encoding is confirmed readable
criteria.behavior: return `ringtone` and `text_tone` as the sound names the Contacts app shows

criteria.trigger: the verification code encoding is confirmed readable
criteria.behavior: return `verification_code` as the value the Contacts app shows

criteria.trigger: a stored Apple-only value cannot be decoded
criteria.behavior: omit that field from the contact read

user_story.capability: every new field to behave like the fields already shipped

criteria.behavior: use the same key for each new field in contact reads and in create or update parameters

criteria.trigger: an update request omits a field
criteria.behavior: leave that field unchanged

criteria.trigger: a search query matches a contact's nickname, maiden name, related name or instant-message username
criteria.behavior: return that contact

criteria.trigger: a throwaway contact carrying every new writable field is created through the MCP server
criteria.behavior: display each field with its intended value and label

criteria.trigger: that throwaway contact is then updated through the MCP server
criteria.behavior: display the changed values and the unchanged fields as before

criteria.trigger: a contact changed on another device after it was read for an update
criteria.behavior: return a conflict error without overwriting the other change
